narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Shock -> Investigation -> On-site Evidence -> Seeking Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The creator is sharing a personal grievance regarding a store that suddenly shut down while still holding her prepaid fees. The video documents her process of confirming the closure and attempting to seek legal help via a consumer protection hotline.
